displayName: Fava Bean + Heavy Feeders (spring N-fixing cover)
benefit: Fall- or early-spring-sown fava bean cover crop (Vicia faba) provides 100 to 200 lb N per acre when terminated at flowering. Ideal preceding heavy-feeding brassicas or solanaceae the same season.

members.title: Fava bean cover 60 days before cash crop
members.body: Sow fava bean at 120 to 150 lb per acre. Terminate by mowing at full bloom, 60 days before cash crop planting. Inoculate with vetch-pea Rhizobium.
